description: Open-LIFU transmitter secure bootloader: X-CUBE-SBSFU 2.8.0 for STM32L443 (TX module). ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 secure boot via the STM32 Cryptographic Library, USB DfuSe and I2C DFU (slaves), anti-rollback floor, one-wire back-channel. SECoreBin is built separately and embedded in the bootloader image.

components.name: STM32Cube MCU Package for STM32L4 (FW_L4)
components.description: STM32Cube package the HAL, CMSIS device files and middleware were generated from. The HAL / CMSIS versions actually in the tree are derived separately.

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: open-lifu-transmitter-bl.ioc: ProjectManager.FirmwarePackage=STM32Cube FW_L4 V1.18.2. HAL v1.13.6 and CMSIS Device L4 v1.7.5 in the tree are the versions STM32CubeL4 v1.18.2 pins (its submodule commits, checked 2026-11-16); the USB Device Library is one release newer than the pack (v2.11.6, see that component).

components.name: STM32 USB Device Library (Core + DFU class)
components.description: USB device stack and DfuSe class used by the bootloader's USB DFU update path. Byte-identical to upstream v2.11.6 except Class/DFU/Src/usbd_dfu.c (bitManifestationTolerant set), see Middlewares/ST/STM32_USB_Device_Library/LOCAL_CHANGES.md.

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: Core/ and Class/DFU/ diffed against upstream tags on 2026-11-16. Core updated from v2.11.5 (the STM32CubeL4 v1.18.2 pin) to v2.11.6 for the usbd_ctlreq.c fixes (USBD_StdEPReq endpoint index > 15 rejected; USBD_GetString bounded); the DFU class did not change between v2.11.5 and v2.11.6.

properties.name: openwater:version-correction
properties.value: the hand-written SBOM listed 1.18.2, which is the FW_L4 package version, not the library version

components.name: X-CUBE-SBSFU (Secure Boot and Secure Firmware Update)
components.description: Secure boot framework (SBSFU/App, SBSFU/Target, SECoreBin) adapted by Openwater for the STM32L443 transmitter. Crypto scheme SECBOOT_ECCDSA_WITH_AES128_CBC_SHA256.

properties.name: openwater:evidence
properties.value: STM32CubeExpansion_SBSFU_V2.8.0 package: Release_Notes.html v2.8.0 / 05-September-2025; ST's sbom_cdx.json for that package lists STM32_Secure_Engine 2.5.4 and STM32 Cryptographic Middleware v3.1.5, the versions in this tree. Modified locally, so not hash-pinned.

properties.name: openwater:advisory-review
properties.value: 2026-11-16: ST SA0034 (KMS key generation, SBSFU 2.2.0-2.6.2), TN1528 (Mbed TLS, SBSFU <= 2.6.2) and SA0050 (bundled Python executables, SBSFU <= 2.7.0) do not apply to 2.8.0

components.name: STM32 Secure Engine
components.description: Secure Engine core and interface (SECoreBin), the protected services used by the SBSFU bootloader.

components.name: STM32 Cryptographic Library (legacy V3, binary)
components.description: Linked binary libSTM32CryptographicV3.0.0_CM4_GCC.a from the V3.1.5 middleware delivery. SECoreBin uses SHA-256, ECDSA P-256 verification and AES-128-CBC decryption only.

properties.name: openwater:support-level
properties.value: Legacy library (UM1924), superseded by X-CUBE-CRYPTOLIB V4+/CMOX, which the console bootloader uses.

properties.name: openwater:advisory-review
properties.value: 2026-11-16: CVE-2020-20949 (Bleichenbacher attack on RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 in this library) does not apply: no RSA function is linked or called (SECoreBin/Src uses SHA256_*, ECDSA*/ECC* verify and AES_CBC_Decrypt_* only).
